verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no vendor documentation claiming a full-featured native mobile app with desktop parity; instead, community reports specifically note mobile gaps (e.g., 'hard to get stuff out of it, especially on mobile', 'unusable on my mobile device' due to login flow, and 'offline/mobile-first... big gap of Notion and ultimately why I had to ditch it'). Missing for 10: any first-party documentation of native mobile app capabilities, feature-parity claims, or independent confirmation that mobile matches desktop functionality.
